messages:
maria (sec): Quick question — for incident triage we want to create timeboxed SIEM snapshots to hand to forensics. Need a short request template: who unwraps KMS, TTL on snapshot, RBAC change duration, and chain-of-custody fields. cc @dina (oncall) @jon (infra)

dina (oncall): I filed one last week for vuln triage. TL;DR: 48h snapshot TTL, KMS unwrap via proxy (no raw CMK), ephemeral analyst role, audit log entry + ticket link.

jon (infra): +1 on 48h default. For legal holds we can allow up to 7d with legal approval. Important: use a JIT KMS proxy so we never grant direct CMK decrypt to humans. kms-bot should record unwraps.

kms-bot: Reminder: KMS unwraps must include justification, ticket ID, and approver. All unwrap events are logged to audit.kms with requestor identity.

maria (sec): Can someone paste a tiny request body we can drop into the runbook so oncall can copy/paste?

eli (sre): Sure — here's what I use (keeps things minimal):

```
Request: SIEM snapshot for INCIDENT-1234
TTL: 48h
Datasets: auth-logs, proxy-telemetry
KMS: unwrap-via -> security-kms-proxy
Analyst role: ephemeral-analyst-access (expires: 48h)
Approver: sec_oncall
Justification: vuln triage - suspected P0 exploit
Ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-1234
Chain-of-custody: ticket + snapshot-tag
Export policy: no external transfer
```

anika (prod): +1. Add an explicit field: 'no export outside company infra' and require presigned S3 URL expiry = 1h if sharing internally.

maria (sec): Who actually creates the ephemeral role and does the KMS unwrap? Ops or infra? I want the handoff documented.

jon (infra): Infra will automate role creation. Workflow we follow: 1) sec opens incident ticket with the template; 2) infra runs `make snapshot` job (CI job) that spins a scratch instance with kms-proxy; 3) job tags snapshot with ticket ID, TTL, and retention label; 4) infra tools create ephemeral role scoped to that ticket and attach a policy with timebound expiry enforced by OPA.

dina (oncall): For urgent legal holds legal needs to be looped before we extend TTL beyond 48h. Sam, can legal sign off on a documented 7-day exception process?

sam (legal): Yes — legal accepts up to 7 days for forensics but we require: (a) documented RM/PO approval in ticket, (b) retention label, (c) explicit chain-of-custody entries. We also need to know if PII is present — then we prefer scrub-first.

maria (sec): Good call. Can we add an automated scrub step for auth logs (remove identifiers) after snapshot creation, to mitigate exposure?

eli (sre): We can add a post-processing scrub job. Example invocation we can put in runbook: `scrubber --rules auth-pii --mode minimize --ticket INCIDENT-1234` — run immediately after snapshot creation and before any unwrap download.

jon (infra): Note: scrubbed outputs still must be key-wrapped with our CMK on the destination bucket. No plaintext copies allowed in ephemeral storage. Also ensure the presigned URL lifetime is short.

maria (sec): Perfect. I'll update the runbook with this template + workflow & add a JIRA request checklist for the legal fields. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
